proof_body:
by
  intro T hT f n _
  unfold fourierCoeff
  refine (MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_integral_norm _).trans_eq ?_
  refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t => ?_)
  simp [norm_smul, fourier_apply]
target_source: ∀ (T : ℝ) [hT : Fact (0 < T)] (f : AddCircle T → ℂ) (n : ℤ), MeasureTheory.Integrable f AddCircle.haarAddCircle → ‖fourierCoeff f n‖ ≤ ∫ t, ‖f t‖ ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle
